Once everyone is ready, select “Start Game” and choose a stage. Everyone will start on the same stage at the same time.
Disband the room?\nAll other players in the room will also be removed from it.
Leave the room?\nThe other players will remain in the room and can continue.
Closing this screen with “Close” will not affect the room (you can return to it through “Multi” on the Home screen).
